title: 18 Malicious npm Packages Deliver Cross-Platform RAT to Alibaba Tool Users
summary: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new set of malicious npm packages that target users of Alibaba developer tools with a cross-platform remote access trojan (RAT) as part of a sophisticated, targeted software supply chain attack targeting Chinese-speaking environments.
